description.value: Steel & Oak Brewing Co. is a New Westminster craft brewery that blends North American and German brewing traditions to produce unfiltered, unpasteurized beers — from a crisp Cold Lager to an Imperial Hefeweizen — all poured in their own tasting room. The venue has both indoor and outdoor seating, and an on-site food truck rounds out the experience with a full menu of burgers, sandwiches, and sides. Community events, live music, and private keg sales make it a genuine neighbourhood destination rather than just a stop for a pint.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Steel & Oak is an active craft brewery tasting room at 1319 3rd Ave, New Westminster, with phone (604) 540-6495 matching OSM. The food menu (food truck) lists a vegan beyond-meat veggie burger explicitly labelled '(vegan)', confirming vegetarian/vegan options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere in the OSM tags or website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Steel & Oak Tasting Room' but the website consistently brands the business as 'Steel & Oak Brewing Co.' — the OSM alt_name 'Steel and Oak Tasting Room' suggests the tasting room is a component of the broader brewery, not a separately named establishment.
No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill information found on the website or in OSM tags — key WWC criteria remain unverified and would need an on-site check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established craft brewery tasting room with food service, indoor and outdoor seating, and a vegan menu option — a solid rest and refuel stop for touring cyclists in New Westminster.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: S&O Veggie Burger explicitly listed as vegan (beyond meat patty, brioche or pretzel bun); Caesar Salad is vegetarian. No GF options mentioned
